hotend_heater.name: Hotend heater cartridge
hotend_heater.function: Heats the hotend block so filament melts; controlled by PID from the hotend thermistor reading.

failure_modes.mode: no or weak heating (open circuit, loose cartridge, failed output)
failure_modes.symptom: slow or no heat-up, 'not heating at expected rate' error, cold prints
failure_modes.check: watch temperature graph during heat-up; measure resistance; check cartridge clamped

failure_modes.mode: control or limit setting wrong (PID, max_temp)
failure_modes.symptom: temperature oscillates or printer shuts down at high temperature
failure_modes.check: compare PID/max_temp with stock config; re-run PID_CALIBRATE

hotend_thermistor.name: Hotend thermistor
hotend_thermistor.function: Measures hotend temperature for the heater control loop and the safety limits.

failure_modes.symptom: 'ADC out of range' or absurd reading, shutdown
failure_modes.check: check connector and wiring; measure resistance at room temperature

failure_modes.mode: wrong sensor configuration (type, pullup, trigger threshold)
failure_modes.symptom: reading offset from real value or false/no trigger
failure_modes.check: compare sensor_type/pullup/threshold with hardware and docs

failure_modes.symptom: spikes, drops or drifting reference between runs
failure_modes.check: wiggle test while watching readings; check mount rigidity

nozzle.name: Nozzle
nozzle.function: 0.4 mm outlet that shapes the molten filament into lines.

failure_modes.symptom: thin, gappy lines; extruder clicks
failure_modes.check: cold pull; extrude in air and watch flow

failure_modes.mode: gap or mismatch in filament path
failure_modes.symptom: leaks, stringing, intermittent jams
failure_modes.check: re-seat tube/nozzle; check fittings

heatbreak_ptfe.name: Heatbreak and PTFE/bowden tube
heatbreak_ptfe.function: Guides filament from extruder into the hot zone and keeps the cold and hot zones separated.

failure_modes.symptom: thin, gappy lines; extruder clicks
failure_modes.check: cold pull; extrude in air and watch flow

failure_modes.mode: gap or mismatch in filament path
failure_modes.symptom: leaks, stringing, intermittent jams
failure_modes.check: re-seat tube/nozzle; check fittings

extruder_motor.name: Extruder motor and driver
extruder_motor.function: Turns the extruder gears to push a metered length of filament into the hotend.

failure_modes.mode: wrong setting (direction, rotation_distance, current, stall threshold)
failure_modes.symptom: moves wrong way, wrong distance, skipped steps or bad homing
failure_modes.check: compare config values with stock and calibrate

failure_modes.symptom: skipping/clicking under load or at high acceleration
failure_modes.check: raise current within limits; check driver temperature and wiring

extruder_gears_guidler.name: Extruder gears and guidler (idler arm)
extruder_gears_guidler.function: Grips the filament between drive gears; guidler sets the grip tension.

failure_modes.symptom: layer shifts, dimensional error, slipping or under-feeding
failure_modes.check: check tension/grub screws/wear; mark and observe slip

failure_modes.symptom: periodic artefacts, noise, uneven motion
failure_modes.check: move by hand with motors off; check alignment

hotend_fan.name: Hotend (heatsink) fan
hotend_fan.function: Cools the heatsink above the heatbreak so filament stays solid until the melt zone.

failure_modes.mode: fan not spinning (failed fan, wiring/polarity, wrong pin)
failure_modes.symptom: fan stops or stutters; overheating of what it cools
failure_modes.check: command fan to 100%; swap with known good fan/port; check polarity

part_cooling_fan.name: Part cooling fan
part_cooling_fan.function: Blows air on freshly extruded plastic so overhangs and bridges solidify.

failure_modes.mode: fan not spinning (failed fan, wiring/polarity, wrong pin)
failure_modes.symptom: fan stops or stutters; overheating of what it cools
